title: Fix the save button that double-submits and never refreshes
acceptanceCriteria: After a save through `useAddTodo`, the todo list refetches and shows the new todo — whichever component called the hook
The mutation stays pending (**Save** disabled) until the refreshed list shows the new todo
Clicking **Save** again while a save is running doesn't send a second request
A failed save keeps what the user typed and shows the error
A successful save clears the input
